atoms.text:
Denise is a wonderful mother. She and her children like to have celebrations in their house with many people from all around the globe.

They invite their friends to their house at the seaside and sit with them on their patio. Denise purchased the house after she had graduated from university.

Her children and university work kept her very busy, but she always passed all of her exams with very good grades.

Over the years, Denise collected a lot of happy memories, and even though she was sometimes frustrated with her kids, she always wished them the good fortune for their future.

atoms.a: What is another expression for 'best of luck'?
